declaredDeviations.reason: guard serves /health from its own handler in services/guard/src/app/main.cc ({"status":"ok","service":"argus-guard"}) and never registers the shared HealthController, so the body is not the envelope; the compose healthcheck for guard polls the status code only (curl -kfs), and every other unit answers the shared envelope

invariants: no probe may answer 5xx except the camera-control 502, which must carry CAMERA_UNREACHABLE
a probe with no token must answer 401, and so must a probe whose token belongs to another device
a malformed JSON body on a ValidJsonFilter route must answer 400
a multipart body must never be answered 400
a JSON answer must carry exactly the {status, info, errors} envelope
a 204 answer must carry an empty body
a volatile key is recorded as <VOLATILE:type>: its key and its JSON type stay compared, its value does not

normalization.maskedHex32: any 32-character lowercase hexadecimal value (a session id)
normalization.maskedShape: a masked key keeps the shape of what it held, so an object under it is still compared field by field
normalization.maskedTokens: any value shaped like a three-part JWT

volatileFields.reason: a camera's health is the stream supervisor's last observation, unknown until its first probe and unreachable after it for the fixture camera; the rest of each row stays pinned

guard's own /health has no envelope and carries internalTls at its top level, beside status and service; it describes the internal certificate the answering process loaded, whose CA's subject is the installation's own and whose days left move every day, so it is never pinned here; lib/http's tls-health-test pins its content, and status and service stay pinned
the model's reply is generated text, so its value is <GENERATED>; the envelope, the key and the string type stay compared, and an error answer is compared in full
the streamed reply is generated text on a 2xx answer, so the body is <GENERATED>; the content type and status stay compared
the last-turn token counters are the model's own bookkeeping of the reply it generated, so they are <GENERATED>; the loaded model, its context and its defaults stay compared
the screen answer is generated text

the push channel's self-test runs on its own schedule, so these fields report the last probe's outcome rather than a contract; sent and unacked count deliveries that drain asynchronously over NATS, so a probe can land before or after the seeded rows' last delivery (seen 7 or 9 on fresh sandboxes); the other counters stay pinned

the hardware verdict, free disk and installed bytes are read from the host that answers, and a component's state comes from the model files and engines present on it; the catalog, lifecycle, sizes and jobs beside them stay pinned
bytes is the disk size of an owner's data on the answering host, so it is read as the placeholder <BYTES> and the answer's shape is still compared; the counts stay pinned

the module's data summary is read live from five owners (the synced change history arrives asynchronously over NATS) and the bytes of its files come from the model files present on the answering host; the refusal, the stops, the role holders, the invitations, the roles an uninstall may give and what keeps running stay pinned, and the data summary itself is pinned by GET /modules/{id}/data
the recommendation is derived from the cores, RAM, ISA and GPU of the host that answers, so it differs between machines; the profile previews beside it stay pinned

internalTls describes the internal certificate the answering process loaded: its CA's subject is the installation's own, the days left move every day and a CA rotation puts two CAs in the bundle, so it is never pinned here; lib/http's tls-health-test pins its content, and every other /health field stays pinned
the transcript is the recognizer's output for one second of silence, so its value is <GENERATED>

the Owner's activity history grows with every write the fleet makes, and the rows reach argus-sync asynchronously over NATS, so the page a probe reads depends on how many had landed; the envelope, the access answers beside it and the filters and paging (pinned by sync-activity-test) stay checked

a heartbeat stamps the second it answers and the presence change it reports, so both move on every call; the guard state, the interval, grace and armed state stay pinned, and the guard state is seeded by seed-golden.py, which publishes one guard heartbeat before the recorder's probes
the synthesized audio is model output, so the 2xx body is <GENERATED>; the audio's content type stays compared
the streamed audio is model output, so the 2xx body is <GENERATED>; the audio's content type stays compared
the caption is generated text, so its value is <GENERATED>; the envelope and the string type stay compared
